From across the ocean comes a glorious new world pantheon.

Obsidian Mirror brings the long-awaited Aztec civilization to Age of Mythology: Retold, delivering a bold new way to play through myth, sacrifice, and divine power.  Inspired by mythology seldom explored in the strategy genre, the Aztecs bring a distinctive tone and worldview to the Age of Mythology experience. 

Lead your people under the guidance of powerful Aztec gods, master fear and illusion, and harvest Tonalli, the life force that fuels the gods themselves.

A sweeping 12-mission campaign spans continents in an epic struggle between sibling deities. From the fall of the utopian city of Aztlan to a myth-shattering journey across Europe and back, alliances will be forged, betrayed, and reclaimed as gods clash and mortals pay the price.
